name: manual_f42d7c
claim: Review closure requires checking review-level nitpicks and nested follow-ups against the current source, and verifying claim-ID provenance across candidate snapshots, semantic state, generated views and episodic corrections; a resolved thread count or green syntax gate alone is not that evidence.

decisions.notes: PT484 and Orama481 residual review: two topic IDs carried copied claims, pseudo-handle causality remained unsupported, and default-port branches lost coverage despite resolved inline threads. Native append-only corrections and mutation-tested fallbacks provide bounded evidence, not host qualification.
